1.

Product Overview

A fire-resistant door system engineered to hold back fire and smoke, giving people and property the time they need — without giving up daily usability.

Fire Rated Shutters & Doors are designed to provide fire-resistant separation between different areas of a building and help restrict the spread of fire and smoke.

They form a critical part of a building's passive fire protection strategy, creating compartments that slow the spread of fire long enough for evacuation and emergency response.

Available in rolling, sliding, hinged and sectional configurations, they are manufactured to suit the fire-rating requirements, opening size and daily traffic of the project — from loading bays to server rooms.

Compartmentation

Creates fire-resistant zones that contain fire and heat at the source.

Rated Protection

Manufactured to meet defined fire-rating and safety standards.

Configurations

Rolling, sliding, hinged and sectional options for every opening.

Automation Ready

Can be integrated with fire alarm and building safety systems.
